notes: The above table depicts of the gross value of products earned by the inmates in
the various trades. Maharashtra state has reported the highest value Rs.1428.0 lakhs of
product earned by inmates followed by Gujarat (Rs.733.8 lakhs) and Bihar (Rs.694.0
lakhs). However, the value of goods produced per inmate was highest in Gujarat
(Rs.8857.9) followed by Punjab (Rs.3265.0), Delhi (Rs.2776.7) and Chandigarh
(Rs.2726.7). Further, the gainful work put in by the jail population not only provides
corrective approach to the mental faculty of the offender, it also goes a long way
developing responsive and respectful attitudes. The prisoners not only develop self
confidence and self esteem out of the valuable labour put in by them, these activities also
lead them towards earning a honourable living in life after release from prison.
